start.description:
Deviations are computed over a time range. This denotes the start timestamp
of that time range.

end.description:
Deviations are computed over a time range. This denotes the end timestamp
of that time range.

interval.description:
Deviations are computed over a time range at a specified {@link Interval} of
the time series data . This denotes the interval of that time range.

aggregationMethod.description:
Deviations computed over the time range are aggregated to a single number. This
specifies the aggregation method. The options are from among functions supported
by the `numpy` python package.

metricName.description:
By default, the `Quantity` metric is evaluated on both {@link Sensor}s to extract
their time series data. However, if another metric is preferred, its name must be
defined in this field.

overrideMetrics.description:
If a metric other than `Quantity` is preferred to evaluate the time series data and
has been defined in the {@link metricName} but is not provisioned, the metric
definition(s) may be passed on-the-fly in this argument.

title:
Parameters that are required arguments to the functions {@link Sensor#computeDeviationFromSensor}
and {@link Sensor#computePairwiseSensorDeviations}.
name: SensorDeviationSpec
